sources.title: [26.19] Lux Mid and Support Season 16 Cheatsheet
Lux Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Illumination
passive.text: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

spells.name: Light Binding
spells.text: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

spells.name: Prismatic Barrier
spells.text: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

spells.name: Lucent Singularity
spells.text: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

spells.name: Final Spark
spells.text: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

damage.value: Lux deals magic burst damage with Light Binding and attacks that consume Illumination marks.

archetype.value: Lux is a ranged mage who binds targets and follows up with attacks to consume her marks.

axis.value: Lux plays lane as a long-range bully who pokes rather than taking extended trades.

winCondition.value: Lux wins through long-range poke, burst damage, utility, and teamfighting.

spikes.why: Lux's Light Binding base damage rises from 80 to 240 as it ranks up.

spikes.at: Final Spark’s cooldown falls from 60 to 40 seconds
spikes.why: Lux can fire its damaging beam more often.

bait.why: Lux loses her two-second immobilize while Light Binding is on its 10-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Lux players should not rely on sidelane pressure because Lux has no sidelane presence.
Lux misses Illumination’s bonus damage if she lets a charged target expire without triggering it.
